title: Suduo Responds to AI Vulgar Videos: Full Apology and Removal

content_html:
Soufun's officially certified e-commerce account "Soufun Personal Care Appliances Store" recently caused a major uproar after posting a large number of AI-generated borderline videos. The videos featured vulgar plots such as "a man enters a bathroom while a woman is showering and suggests helping her wash her back" and "a cleaner enters a women's restroom and says he has seen everything." Many netizens expressed disgust, criticizing the content as "vulgar for attention," and even questioned Soufun products for being "overpriced and low quality." On August 5, Soufun made an emergency response, stating that all involved videos had been removed and admitted that the authorized store's content management and review mechanisms had failed.

According to reports, the account was promoting Soufun's high-temperature steam cleaner by posting multiple AI-generated borderline content. One video used the selling point of "two men in a bathroom with a woman suddenly entering to demonstrate the cleaning function," while other videos directly used sexually suggestive scenarios as traffic magnets. After the videos were posted, public opinion quickly escalated, with netizens not only criticizing the advertisement as vulgar and offensive but also directing their anger towards the brand itself, shouting "Your ad is really low," and questioning the operation team for having no boundaries. Currently, the account's homepage only retains three normal product explanation videos, and all borderline content has been removed.

Regulation of AI-generated content remains a blind spot in the industry

In its response, Soufun stated that it removed the problematic videos on the same day and conducted a comprehensive review of the material review process, while further strengthening the content management and review mechanism for authorized stores. However, this incident highlights the core issue: AI tools have greatly reduced the threshold for producing low-quality content, and if companies relax their review and control, their brand image may suffer serious backlash in a short time.

content_html_zh:
搜房网官方认证电商账号“搜房个人护理用品店”近日因发布大量人工智能生成的边缘视频而引起轩然大波。 这些视频包含“一名男子在一名女子洗澡时进入浴室并建议帮她洗背”和“一名清洁工进入女厕所并说他看到了一切”等低俗情节。 许多网友表示厌恶，批评内容“庸俗博眼球”，甚至质疑搜房产品“价格过高、质量低劣”。 8月5日，搜房网紧急回应，称已删除所有涉案视频，并承认授权店的内容管理和审核机制失灵。

据报道，该账户通过发布多个人工智能生成的边缘内容来宣传搜房的高温蒸汽清洁机。 其中一个视频以“两个男人在浴室里，一个女人突然闯入来演示清洁功能”为卖点，而其他视频则直接使用性暗示场景来吸引流量。 视频发布后，舆论迅速升级，网友不仅批评广告粗俗、无礼，还将愤怒矛头指向品牌本身，大喊“你的广告真low”，质疑运营团队无底线。 目前，该账号首页仅保留三个正常的产品讲解视频，所有边界内容均已被删除。

人工智能生成内容的监管仍然是行业盲点

搜房网在回应中表示，已于当天下架了问题视频，并对素材审核流程进行了全面审查，同时进一步加强了授权店的内容管理和审核机制。 然而，这一事件凸显了一个核心问题：人工智能工具大大降低了低质量内容的制作门槛，如果企业放松审查和管控，其品牌形象可能会在短时间内遭受严重反弹。
